name: @engenox/crypto
description: The WORM (Write-Once-Read-Many) signature — the R2 fence of the dual-canonical two-fence (CLAUDE.md §2: a DB clone without the KEK is unintelligible; an R2 clone without the sig is unverifiable). The thin-column ships the SIGNATURE fence real: ed25519 sign + verify over a deterministic canonical serialization (node:crypto ed25519, verified in Node 22 stdlib — no external crypto dep). The ENVELOPE-ENCRYPTION fence (HSM-backed KEK → per-tenant DEK, quarterly rotation) is deferred to the thickening pass (forward-referenced TODO in src) — honestly named as deferred, NOT faked. A generic signer of bytes; callers canonicalize the row (the access contract is not coupled to a specific message here). A tampered row fails verify; a re-canonicalized row verifies deterministically.
